newsitem.title: USA: Moore Cty, N.C., approves $11.5 mln GO bond vote.
newsitem.headline: Moore Cty, N.C., approves $11.5 mln GO bond vote.

text.p: North Carolina's Moore Couunty Board of Education approved a Nov. 4 referendum on $11.5 million of general obligation bonds for improvements at Sandhills Community College, the Fayetteville Observer-Times said Tuesday.

But the board voted to delay a second referendum on $26.9 million of GO bonds for public school construction. The county school board sought the delay pending results of a study to determine whether that amount is adequate to cover school needs.

The public school bonds had been originally planned to go on the ballot in November. The school board expects results of the study in 60 days and may seek to put a revised referendum on the ballot in May, the newspaper said.
